extraction.Name: Susie McCloskey Whipple
extraction.Refused/Protested: No, I said nothing, just accepted it.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: my husband wanted to sell it to pay other obligations
extraction.NOTES: Patent given at the Cut Meat Issue Station by Mr. Gardner, government farmer. Did not sign a receipt for the patent. Husband sold land for $2,000.00; abstract cost $6.90; proceeds received by husband. Husband promised another quarter in place of it, which she never got. Husband and wife have separated. Four children, all dependent on her. Never made application for patent. Superintendent: E. E. McKean. Document dated April 9, 1929.
